mode: built-in image generation, sequential single-image calls
shared_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source for a 32x32 pixel-art game collectible icon
Primary request: <subject>
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #FF00FF chroma-key background for removal
Style/medium: polished retro pixel art, hard pixel clusters, crisp silhouette, limited palette, readable when reduced to 32x32, consistent with a fantasy-industrial roguelite inventory icon
Composition/framing: exactly one centered object, square canvas, generous even padding, object fills about 70 percent of canvas
Lighting/mood: simple upper-left highlight, restrained contrast
Constraints: opaque object, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no frame, no badge, no cast shadow, no floor, no reflection, background must be perfectly uniform #FF00FF, do not use magenta anywhere in the object
Avoid: photorealism, smooth gradients, soft antialiasing, clutter, extra objects
